title: A Geometric Witness Framework for Signed Multivariate Tail-Dependence Compatibility: Asymptotic Structure and Finite-Thr
summary: This paper presents a geometric framework for studying multivariate tail-dependence compatibility in copulas, developing a witness representation indexed by active coordinate sets and sign patterns. The author derives a Moebius-type synthesis with explicit triangular inversion for complete signed tail families, and characterizes finite-threshold compatibility through nonnegative recovered generator weights and normalization constraints.
key_points: The paper develops a geometric witness representation for studying lower-tail, upper-tail, and mixed tail-dependence configurations in multivariate copulas
For complete signed tail families, witness generator weights are recovered via explicit triangular inversion using 3^d - 1 generator weights
Finite-threshold compatibility is characterized by three conditions: nonnegative recovered generator weights, singleton normalization, and residual central-mass constraint
The framework provides tools for realization, simulation, calibration, completion, repair, and scenario design of copulas
The analysis treats partial, noisy, or inconsistent specifications using linear-feasibility and weighted-l1 recovery problems
Author: Janusz Milek; Primary category: math.ST
